description: Explore project file structure and read source code. Actions: tree (list directory contents with recursive depth control), content (read file at specific ref/branch), download_attachment (get uploaded file by secret+filename). Related: manage_files to create/update files.

action.description: Action to perform: tree, content, download_attachment

file_path.description: Path to the file to read Required for 'content' action(s).

filename.description: Original filename of the attachment. Required for 'download_attachment' action(s).

path.description: Directory path to list Required for 'tree' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'tree' action(s).

recursive.description: Include nested directories Required for 'tree' action(s).

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA Required for 'tree', 'content' action(s).

secret.description: Security token from the attachment URL. Required for 'download_attachment' action(s).

name: browse_files
